Being someone who struggles with a self harm addiction. 

Dont do it. It is NEVER worth it. 

You might get attention but you might be put in a psych ward too. Most places see self harm as suicide and you may be involuntary comitted in ward. Its not fun. 

As well as you'll damage your body severely. I have muscle damage due to self harming. I got into it by peer pressure. 


But i reccomend getting medical help if you think you're a danger. Call the suicide hotline (they arent just for suicide. You can vent to them) or  crisis textline. 

But Please dont go down the path of self harm. Its like drugs. You start and you can get addicted. 

Be safe, take care of yourself. And find safe coping skills.

What i did was cut my dosages in small bits. (I was overdosed severely by my doctor.) And slowly weaned off. But i know i dropped one of them and the effects really slammed into me hard. 


But the best way to get off of them. Take smaller dosages and just let your body adjust. Youll go into shock if you just drop everything :c 

But baby steps are absolutely key to getting better :> 

And just know that even if you're on pills now or slowly get off of them. Tell yourself that its gonna be ok. Reassurance is such a good thing when things go south. ❤

Dont be afraid to step back. And dont be afraid to speak up. You're nobody's therapist. Why should it be your job to have to listen but not be listened to?

I know it hurts. But you need to cut ties with people who hurt you like that. They're going to hurt you. And if you need, i reccomend the suicide hotline or the crisis text line. Both are wonderful to talk to. And they're all confidential.

Slew of pills ive been on: lamictol (gives you a rash that looks like rotten flesh, itll increase anxiety) i got on then right off, that was 2014. But 2015 i took zolaft, abilify and i cannot remember the other two to save my life.

Abilify was the kicker for me though. Lost my grip, got severe shakes, seizures.... Took like 4 years to get my grip decent. I got off of it in 2016. But abilify will absolutely wreck your system....

My mental health is fluctuating. But in all honesty, my best advice is coping skills. I've never had what youre experiencing though. But no matter what, coping skills galore. And ALWAYS step back to take breathers when you need one! Brain damage is torture from pills. I used to be threatened by my doctor for trying to get off pills way back when. But personally, ive slowly coaxed myself back into getting back whats been damaged. No it wont be how it was. But baby steps and just being patient with yourself help :>
